The '''War of Flowering Knives''' was a [[Millennium/Legends|thousand-year]] conflict during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era. It was eventually ended by the intervention of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[To-La]].
